bio_en: Tigran Yerkat (Karapet Pilezikji) was a little-known young patriot, likened to a shy flower that fills the valleys with fragrance while staying hidden. Frail in body, he followed with bitter anguish the tragedy unfolding in the homeland. His letters, written from Athens in May and October 1897, reveal his devotion to the cause. He died young, and Droshak published a belated tribute to him in March 1900.
notes: Compiled from the archive review, 2026-10-12. Confidence: low. Dates of life not given in the portion read.
